reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: src/version.rs defines image-owned version bytes. The module defines one four-byte C character array initialized from the exact 712 NUL literal; no allocator or initializer callback creates it.
owner_creation.invariant: Version bytes reside in static storage.
limitations: The four-byte version object includes its terminal NUL; output buffers are separate owners.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/version.rs exports version as borrowed C bytes. The exported version symbol is borrowed by command::dispversion, optfunc::opt__V and lesskey_parse numeric parsing; maintained call sites read its bytes.
aliases_escapes.invariant: C string readers borrow a four-byte NUL string.
limitations: Public C mutability permits external writes beyond the inspected readers.

callback_targets.analysis: src/version.rs uses transmute for array representation only. The transmute changes the four-byte array element representation only; the module registers no callback or code pointer.
callback_targets.invariant: Array conversion cannot create callback ownership.
limitations: The array transmute establishes no function-pointer ABI guarantee.

invalidation.analysis: src/version.rs has no runtime replacement of version. There is no replace, resize or free operation in the module, and repository references contain no assignment to the array.
invalidation.invariant: The backing array address remains stable.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/version.rs initializes the version array as one object. The entire initialized array is installed by static initialization; readers never see a length/pointer pair being committed separately.
mutation_commit.invariant: All four version bytes are initialized before main.

release_pair.analysis: src/version.rs requires version aliases to remain unfreed. Neither the exported symbol nor pointers into it may be passed to free; its owner is the loaded image for the process lifetime.
release_pair.invariant: Static image storage is never heap-released.
limitations: No caller may infer malloc ownership from the exported version address.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/version.rs needs no allocation recovery for version. Initialization is infallible; display or parse failure does not transfer ownership of the array to its caller.
error_cleanup.invariant: Reader errors retain the original version owner.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/version.rs installs no asynchronous writer of version. Version display may run during command processing but this module installs no signal handler and performs no asynchronous writes.
signals_handoff.invariant: Current maintained users only read version storage.
limitations: The C symbol is mutable in its ABI; this review assumes maintained callers and does not certify an external writer.

src/command.rs.relationship: dispversion at src/command.rs:1454-1463 borrows the version array address into PARG and calls error; the command does not acquire or free those image bytes.

src/optfunc.rs.relationship: The version option handler at src/optfunc.rs:1085-1104 lends the static version pointer for formatted output; its output storage is separate from version.rs ownership.

src/lesskey_parse.rs.relationship: Version initialization at src/lesskey_parse.rs:1641-1647 parses the static version C string into numeric state without taking ownership of its bytes.
